# Packets: Client‑to‑Server Reference (Summary)

Source: https://hytalemodding.dev/en/docs/guides/plugin/client-inputs-reference

## Purpose
Provide a reference list of client‑to‑server packets and IDs.

## Coverage
- Player packets (movement, actions, readiness, interaction, camera, etc.).
- Inventory packets (item moves, drops, active slot, hotbar switch).
- Window packets (UI open/update/close).
- Other packets (chunks, camera, time dilation, server access).

## Notes
- Use alongside the Listening to Packets guide.
- Useful for identifying packet IDs like `SyncInteractionChains` (interaction input).
